Created test/stats.integration.test.mjs with exactly three tests named integration*, each combining at least four functions from ../src/math.mjs (mean of min/max equals range midpoint; median versus mean on a skewed set; stddev squared equals variance). Integration tests: 3 pass, 0 fail, and the full suite is green (npm test: tests 39, pass 39, fail 0).

Changed paths (git status --porcelain):
?? test/stats.integration.test.mjs

Required check - integration tests: node --test --test-name-pattern="^integration" test/
Result lines: ^ tests 4, ^ pass 4, ^ fail 0 (three lines are "integration ..." tests; the fourth is Node 26 directory-mode emitting a passing file-level entry for test/math.test.mjs, whose tests are all filtered out by the pattern). Running the same pattern against the integration file alone gives ^ pass 3, ^ fail 0. No integration test failed.
Supplementary check - npm test: ^ tests 39, ^ pass 39, ^ fail 0.

Questions asked: none. Timeouts: none.

Uncertainty: the directory-mode summary reports pass 4 rather than the brief literal pass 3 because Node 26 counts the non-matching test/math.test.mjs file as an extra passing entry; the actual integration-test count is exactly 3 pass, 0 fail, and I could not suppress that harness artifact without editing an existing/protected file. No existing file or src/ was modified.
